strongest_defensible_result: On the 80 prospectively selected full320 payload blocks, the fixed pilot80-trained A/B-orthogonalized C intervention extended prospectively to meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct revision 1605565b47bb9346c5515c34102e054115b4f98b: the predeclared layer-74-minus-layer-13 purpose-interaction response was positive, dose-linear, and larger than the frozen random-direction calibration threshold under copied pilot80 readouts.

chronology.known_before_freeze: The two-model payload-disjoint transfer had already returned positive effects in Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.3-70B, and prior observational activation banks for Llama-3.1-70B had been inspected.
chronology.prospective_unknown: No matched pilot-trained orthogonalized-C intervention output for this Llama-3.1-70B checkpoint existed before the extension preregistration and executable plans were frozen.
chronology.classification: Prospective new-checkpoint model extension after a known positive result; not independent source-bank confirmation and not a third member of the original two-model decision family.

descriptive_robustness.interpretation: The extension effect is positive and robust across the frozen payload blocks, but descriptively smaller than both already-known model effects. No cross-model scaling law was preregistered or tested.

local_archive.verification: independent remote/local byte-size and SHA-256 equality

classification_rationale: Every prospectively frozen success condition passed for the new checkpoint: complete and valid raw execution, positive primary and high-layer tests, positive half-dose high-minus-low response, and primary effect above the frozen absolute-random 97.5th-percentile threshold. This supports a positive checkpoint extension of the narrow internal causal-transfer result. The source bank and assay were inherited after a known positive result, so the conclusion remains an extension rather than independent confirmation.
allowed_interpretation: The fixed pilot-train/full320-transfer orthogonalized-C internal causal response prospectively generalized to the frozen Llama-3.1-70B checkpoint, preserving the predeclared high-versus-low layer ordering with dose and random-control support.
forbidden_interpretations: The response is a pure semantic or format-independent mechanism.
The full A/B/C factorial mechanism replicated in Llama-3.1-70B.
The intervention behaviorally steers evaluation awareness.
The effect is universal across Llama models or model families.
The smaller Llama-3.1-70B effect establishes a model-size or version scaling law.
The extension retroactively changes the original two-model decision or the negative pilot80 factorial decision.
